controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.body: The DKCover platform is provided by DEKA Editions, responsible for media coverage and communication for the "Public-Private Partnerships (PPP) Togo 2026" event. DEKA Editions is not the event organizer. The official PPP Togo 2026 organizer remains the data controller, with DEKA Editions operating the platform technically.

data.title: 2. Data processed
data.accessBody: badge code or QR, optional event access code, stored locally in your browser (sessionStorage) for the duration of your visit.
data.mediaBody: anonymized statistics (view/download actions, hashed IP address, browser type) to measure gallery usage.
data.searchBody: selfie temporarily sent for facial matching. It is neither stored nor kept after the search. Only photos already published in albums you can access are analyzed.
data.facesBody: digital signatures (embeddings) are generated from faces detected in official photos, solely to enable selfie search.

purposes.title: 3. Purposes
purposes.body: Data is processed exclusively to: grant access to authorized albums, enable media downloads, help you find your photos via facial recognition, and produce aggregated audience statistics for the organizer.

legal.title: 4. Legal basis
legal.body: Gallery access is based on your participation in the event and, where applicable, implicit consent when using "My photos". Anonymized statistics rely on the organizer's legitimate interest in measuring service usage.

retention.title: 5. Retention period
retention.selfie: Selfie: deleted immediately after processing (not stored).
retention.session: Browser access code: 24 hours maximum (local session).
retention.embeddings: Photos and facial embeddings: kept for the duration of the event and deleted within a reasonable time after it ends, unless legally required otherwise.
retention.stats: Anonymized statistics: kept for reporting purposes, without direct identification.

recipients.title: 6. Recipients
recipients.body: Data is accessible to authorized technical teams (hosting, maintenance) and event organizers. No sale or transfer to commercial third parties. Hosting is provided on secure servers.

rights.title: 7. Your rights
rights.body: Under applicable data protection principles, you may request access, rectification or deletion of your data, and object to certain processing where permitted by law. To exercise your rights, contact the PPP Togo 2026 organizer through official event communication channels.

security.title: 8. Security
security.body: Technical and organizational measures are in place: restricted album access, encrypted communications (HTTPS), request rate limiting, hashed IP addresses in statistics, and isolated facial processing on controlled infrastructure.

camera.title: 9. Camera and QR scan
camera.body: Camera access is used only locally in your browser to scan a badge QR code. No video stream is recorded or sent to the server.
